top_violation_types.title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence from the DFPS investigation, a child in care received an injury that required medical attention, and the caregiver did not provide first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a staff member was not relating to children with courtesy or respect as they called children names that were not kind.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Training Criteria - Provided By (26 TAC §746.1317(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A staff member who is not designated as a director and not certified to train issued 2 training certificates to a new staff member.

top_violation_types.title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation director has not obtained their director's renewal permit since January 16,2022.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not know who they were responsible to pick up  on the day of the incident. As a result, the operation failed to pick up two children from elementary school.
